# agentic-speech

Route text to speech across ElevenLabs, OpenAI, and Cartesia.

Keywords: text-to-speech, elevenlabs, agentic-suite, claude-code, codex, cli, mcp.

- SDK: import { synthesizeSpeech, listVoices } from "agentic-speech".
- CLI: agentic-speech speak --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-speech mcp, then call synthesize_speech.
